name: ModelVariant764_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant764_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (after the delay a burst of textured shards flies out in front of the slot while the light dims and recovers, and growing rings of quads and a cone of triangles spread out and fade); for a non-negative request it selects the 0x20-byte command row indexed by the request and seeds the rings, cone, shards and flash quad, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 during the delay, 1 on the first drawn frame, 0 while the effect runs and 2 at its end; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the PAL header-781 and 878 images build the same source directly at the same addresses. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
